title: Playboy Magazine May 1993 Dian Parkinson Charles Barkley Giorgio Armani
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue, complete. Normal signs of age and storage; possible scuffs, scratches, creases and edge/corner wear. Please review the photos for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, May 1993 issue. Cover price $4.95.

Features:
- Dian Parkinson: An Erotic Encore - cover and pictorial
- Playboy Interviews Charles Barkley
- Giorgio Armani: 20 Elegant Questions
- Susie Owens: From Playmate to Superhero

NOTE ON THE PHOTOS: this issue is at TOP LEFT in the group photo and SECOND FROM TOP in the stack.
